horoscopes.title: Aries Weekly Horoscope Starting September 27
content: Mars, your ruler is continuing through the fire sign of Leo, so the creative energies will be high. Children will enter an important phase involving examinations, admissions, competitions, sports, or decisions about their future. You will spend more time and money handling their requirements. Students will face a demanding academic schedule and will work intensely toward examinations or competitive tests. A romantic relationship will become more passionate, while disagreements over attention or possessiveness will create temporary friction. Singles will begin a strong attraction that develops quickly. There will be activities like creative content creation, sports, and other competitive events as well. Speculative investments will show sudden fluctuations, so, don’t invest huge money in anything as there are chances for losses.

This is a very important week for relationships as the Sun will impact your seventh house. Differences of opinion will lead to direct conversations and definite conclusions. Business partnerships will enter an active phase, with meetings, negotiations, documentation, and new proposals taking priority. You will sign or revise an agreement after detailed discussions. Professionals dealing directly with clients will receive increased enquiries and assignments. Legal negotiations will progress through meetings and paperwork. An important new professional connection will also develop.

Venus transit through your eighth house will bring important developments involving joint finances, inheritance, insurance, loans, taxes, investments, and your partner’s money. A pending insurance settlement, reimbursement, inheritance matter, or financial claim will show progress. Married people will discuss shared expenses, savings, debts, and major purchases with their partner. Your spouse’s financial situation will improve through income, benefits, or another source. Intimacy in marriage will increase, and private relationship matters will receive greater attention. Some will receive money, valuables, or financial support through family or a partner. Expenses connected with taxes, loans, medical needs, or repairs will also arise. Financial documents will require careful handling.

horoscopes.title: Taurus Weekly Horoscope Starting September 27
content: Mars will continue through your fourth house, so there will be plenty happening at home. A repair that you have been postponing will finally need to be done, or you will decide to replace something that is no longer useful. Property discussions will also become active. Some will visit a house or apartment, speak to an agent, or enquire about a loan before making a purchase. If you are planning to move, the search for a suitable place will gather pace. A vehicle will require servicing, repair, or additional spending. There will also be a family matter that needs everyone to sit together and reach a decision. Your mother will need your support for something important.

The solar transit through Libra will impact the sixth house, so you will have a lot of work. A project that has been dragging on will finally reach a stage where decisions have to be made. There will also be corrections to make or documents to resubmit. Job seekers will hear from employers regarding interviews, tests, or the next round of selection. An issue with a colleague will come up for discussion and will finally get some clarity. You will also deal with bills, loan repayments, insurance, or other pending payments. This transit will bring minor health issues, which means you have to get the correct diet.

Venus, your ruler is moving through the seventh house, so, singles will meet someone special, but please try to understand each other. Those already dating will start talking seriously about marriage or their future together. Married couples will make plans for a journey, celebration, purchase, or family function. There will also be more invitations and opportunities to go out together. Business owners will meet potential partners and clients, and a deal that has been under discussion will move forward. New contracts and collaborations will come up for negotiation.

horoscopes.title: Gemini Weekly Horoscope Starting September 27
content: Mars is moving through the fire sign of Leo, so you will have a lot of work. You can expect short journeys, transfer, department change or upskilling. Since Mars is a natural malefic, you will have a tendency to argue, and you will work with multiple projects from communication-based domain. A sibling will approach you regarding an important decision or personal matter. Those working in media, writing, sales, marketing, or digital platforms will take up new assignments. You will also handle applications, documents, presentations, or agreements. There will be some maintenance regarding electronic devices. The neck and shoulder area will be very sensitive, so you have to take care of that.

This week will further gain momentum as the Sun will be in Libra, which rules the fifth house of creativity and team activity. Children will have important developments connected with studies, examinations, admissions, competitions, or extracurricular activities. Parents will spend more time handling their needs and making decisions about their future. This is a very important time for students as they will have some academic projects. Love life can become complex as there will be arguments. Please make sure you don’t trust newly met people as they all may not be genuine.

Your workplace and health will be very important as Venus is moving through Scorpio. Your relationship with colleagues will improve, and an earlier disagreement at work will finally settle. A new colleague or team member will join, making your work easier. Those looking for jobs will receive interview calls or useful leads. There will be some medical expenses, but this is just the part of the transit. Pending bills, loan payments, and other dues will also require attention. Office celebrations, team lunches, or informal gatherings will increase. Some will develop an attraction toward a colleague or meet someone through the workplace.

horoscopes.title: Cancer Weekly Horoscope Starting September 27
content: There will be some financial needs as Mars is moving through Leo, which rules your second house. Your expenses will rise because of household needs, repairs, family responsibilities, or an important purchase. A discussion about money within the family will become heated, especially when responsibilities have to be divided. Some will receive a pending payment and use it immediately for an existing obligation. New opportunities can come in fulltime or part-time mode. Documents connected with savings, taxes, banking, or investments will need attention. Please avoid hurried purchases, otherwise you may misuse your money.

Your home and family will be the core theme during this week due to the solar transit. A decision regarding renovation, repairs, relocation, or the purchase of household items will finally move forward. Some will begin searching for a house, land, or rental property, while others will deal with property documents or registration matters. Your mother will need your attention regarding an important personal or practical matter. Family members will gather to discuss a decision concerning the home or property. Vehicle servicing, repairs, or purchase plans will also come up. The Sun will aspect the tenth house, so there will be some complex projects as well.

The creative energies will be high as Venus is moving through the fifth house. Singles will meet someone interesting through friends, social events, studies, or common interests, while an existing romance will become more serious. Parents will have good news connected with a child’s studies, admission, performance, or achievements. Creative projects will come up, so those working in writing, design, media, entertainment, fashion, or the arts will receive opportunities to showcase their work. However, it will be a bad idea to invest in risky projects. There will also be more outings, celebrations, movies, hobbies, and social events. Some will spend money on children, gifts, entertainment, or a romantic partner.

horoscopes.title: Leo Weekly Horoscope Starting September 27
content: Mars will move through your first house, making this a very active period with several matters demanding your direct involvement. This is the time to take leadership roles, so you will try to push yourself. Since Mars and Leo has fire element, you will be fast and furious. Arguments will arise when others challenge your decisions, so disagreements with colleagues or family members will need handling. You will also start a new project, fitness programme, or personal initiative. Minor cuts, burns and other injuries will be the part of this transit.

The solar transit is moving through Libra, so you will have a lot work to do. You will have frequent meetings, phone calls, emails, and discussions connected with work or business. There will be short projects, short trips, and short meetings online and offline. Those working in writing, media, sales, marketing, teaching, or online platforms will become busier and receive greater visibility. An important document, application, or agreement will require your attention. A sibling will have a significant development and will involve you in their plans. You will also take the initiative to restart a project that has remained pending. The neck and shoulder area will be very sensitive too.

This is the time to decorate your home and solve the family issues as Venus is moving through the fourth house. This Venus transit will make you buy some devices for home, like furniture, or other devices. Some will finalise a rental property, move into a new home, or begin discussions about buying a house or land. Plans to purchase or upgrade a vehicle will also move forward. Family gatherings, visitors, celebrations, or meals at home will increase. Your mother will have a positive development in her personal life. Those involved in property, interiors, hospitality, or home-based businesses will receive new enquiries and opportunities.

horoscopes.title: Virgo Weekly Horoscope Starting September 27
content: You will feel like being alone as Mars is impacting the twelfth house. Money will go towards travel, medical needs, repairs, loan payments, or an unexpected family requirement. Some will travel abroad or begin serious preparations involving visas, tickets, accommodation, or official documents. Work connected with foreign companies or overseas clients will become active. A pending matter in a hospital, government office, or another institution will require repeated follow-up. Sleep will become disturbed because of a demanding schedule or late working hours. Hidden disagreements will also surface, and an old issue will finally need to be addressed directly.

The Sun will move through your second house, putting money, family responsibilities, savings, and income matter firmly in focus. You will have an important discussion about household expenses or the way financial responsibilities are being shared. A pending payment, salary matter, or other source of income will require follow-up. Some will make a major purchase for the family or spend money on an important requirement. Banking, tax, insurance, or investment documents will need attention. There will also be discussions about family property or valuables. Those working in business will review pricing and income, to make necessary changes. New part time or fulltime job opportunities will come up.

The third house of multitasking will be impacted by Venus as it is moving through Scorpio. A short trip with your partner, friends, or family will come up, and some will travel for a celebration or social event. Venus will surely improve the sibling bond, and siblings will have some good news. There will be online and offline meetings as the part of the projects. Those who work in writing, teaching and publishing related domain will have more work. Messages and conversations will also bring a new romantic connection for some. You will buy electronic gadgets, and there will be transfer or relocation.

horoscopes.title: Libra Weekly Horoscope Starting September 27
content: Mars is moving through your eleventh house, and this is a very impactful transit for investments, long term plans and friendships. A pending payment, incentive, commission, or business income will finally come through, while some will find an additional source of earnings. Your professional network will expand, and a useful contact will help you move an important plan forward. Since Mars is a natural malefic, there are chances for power struggles in the team. Friends will involve you in meetings, events, or new ventures. Business owners will actively pursue larger profits and new customers.

The Sun will move through your first house, putting you at the centre of several important developments. You will take charge of a matter that has been waiting for a firm decision and will become more visible at work or in public dealings. Meetings with senior people, officials, or management will become important. Some will receive a new responsibility, leadership role, or opportunity to represent their team. Personal plans that were kept aside will start moving again. Your schedule will become busier with appointments, travel, and official work. Differences with others will arise when decisions are challenged. There are chances for headaches, or heat related diseases during this time.

Venus is moving through your second house, bringing positive developments in income, savings, family matters, and valuable possessions. A salary increase, pending payment, new job, incentive, or additional source of income will bring some financial relief. Business owners will see better collections or improved sales. You will also spend money on clothes, jewellery, good food, household items, or a family celebration. Some will purchase something valuable that has been planned for some time. Family gatherings and important discussions will increase, and an earlier disagreement with a relative will settle. Those earning through communication, consulting, beauty, fashion, food, or creative work will receive useful opportunities during this period.

horoscopes.title: Scorpio Weekly Horoscope Starting September 27
content: This is a very important phase for your career as Mars is moving through Leo. This transit has the power to bring new job opportunities. New tasks, new projects and changes in the existing project also can come up. Job seekers will become more aggressive in their search and attend interviews. Those planning a job change will start sending applications and speaking to recruiters. Leo is the sign for creative skills, so business owners and freelancers will get new projects. Disagreements will also be the part of this transit. Those who work in sports, admin and army will get new tasks.

The solar transit through Libra can make you anxious about your personal life and you need privacy. An overseas journey or its preparations will take up your time, especially visas, tickets, accommodation, or other documents. Those working with foreign companies or international clients will have important meetings and assignments. Expenses will increase through travel, medical needs, family commitments, or an unexpected payment. Some will visit a hospital or government institution regarding a pending matter. Work will also require more privacy, research, or preparation away from the usual environment. There will be issues like irregular sleep.

Your personal life and appearance will get highlighted as Venus is moving through your sign. This is the time for refinement, so many of you will buy new accessories to improve your looks. Even though the Sun is making you a bit detached, you will get opportunities to meet new people. Single Scorpio will get the closest opportunities to find someone special. Couples will find more opportunities to go out and spend time together. This transit will also work well for people who meet clients regularly, as new contacts and useful introductions will come in. Creative assignments will pick up too.

horoscopes.title: Sagittarius Weekly Horoscope Starting September 27
content: You will be highly active and adventurous as Mars is moving through Leo, which rules the ninth house of long trips, foreign collaborations and studies. There are chances for long trips for studies, job or pilgrimages. Students will become busy with university applications, entrance examinations, research work, or decisions about further studies. Those trying to move abroad will push their plans forward. A legal or official matter will also require repeated follow-up. There will be differences of opinion with your father, teacher, or another senior person. Work involving international clients, publishing, training, or education will bring new assignments and responsibilities.

The debilitated Sun will move through your eleventh house, and matters connected with income, professional gains, friends, and your wider network will need more attention. A payment, incentive, commission, or expected financial gain will get delayed, forcing you to follow up more than once. At work, support expected from a senior person or influential contact will not come as easily as planned. A friend or team member will also disagree with you over a shared plan. Group projects will move slowly because everyone will have different priorities. Some professional contacts will prove less useful than expected. This is the transit to listen to others than airing your opinions.

Amid the busy schedule, you want some alone time, as Venus is moving through the water sign of Scorpio. Some of you will plan a holiday or travel abroad with your partner or family, while others will spend money preparing for an overseas journey. A relationship with someone living far away will become more active through calls, messages, or a meeting. Those working with foreign companies or international clients will receive new assignments and contacts. There will also be expenses on hotels, beauty treatments, clothes, gifts, or entertainment. Couples will look for more private time together. For some, an old romantic connection will quietly return and lead to further conversations.

horoscopes.title: Capricorn Weekly Horoscope Starting September 27
content: For Capricorn Sun, Moon and rising signs, the financial matters will be very important as Mars is moving through Leo. You will have to follow up on an insurance claim, tax matter, reimbursement, or money that is jointly held with someone else. Married people will have discussions about their partner’s income, debts, or shared expenses. An inheritance or property matter will also become active for some. Sudden expenses will be the part of the transit, so make sure you have some savings. An issue that has remained hidden will also come out unexpectedly.

The Sun will move through your tenth house, making career and professional matters much more important. You will be given a responsibility that puts your work directly in front of managers or senior officials. A pending project will reach an important stage, and you will have to take the lead in getting things completed. Some will receive a new designation, additional authority, or an opportunity to handle a major assignment. Job seekers will hear about suitable openings and attend interviews. Meetings with management will increase, and important decisions about your role will be discussed. Business owners will deal with government officials or established clients. Your professional visibility will increase considerably during this period.

Venus will move through your eleventh house, and there will be some good developments around income, friends, and professional contacts. You will focus on getting long-term money-making projects through your team mates. There will be pleasant conversations with friends, and team mates. Someone in your network will introduce you to a useful professional contact or client. Business owners will see better sales and repeat customers. Singles will meet someone through friends or professional circles. A long-pending wish involving a purchase, journey, or personal plan will finally move forward.

horoscopes.title: Aquarius Weekly Horoscope Starting September 27
content: The seventh house of relationships is highly active as Mars is moving through Leo, which rules the seventh house. One conversation will turn into an argument when neither person is ready to back down. If you are already having problems in your marriage, those issues will come up again and will have to be dealt with. Business partnerships will also become busy. A partner will want to change the way something is being handled, leading to several discussions. New clients will come in, but some will be demanding. Contracts, negotiations, and legal matters will move forward. Singles will also meet someone who is confident, direct, and quick to make their interest known.

You have to be careful with long trips, as the Sun is moving through the ninth house and it is debilitated. Some will travel for work, higher studies, a family matter, or an official purpose, while those planning to go abroad will become busy with applications, visas, tickets, and other documents. Students will hear about admissions, examinations, scholarships, or university matters. A decision involving your father will also require your attention. Legal cases and government-related matters will see further movement after a period of waiting. Those working in education, publishing, law, training, or international business will receive new responsibilities.

Your career will get a natural boost as Venus is moving through the tenth house. Some will receive a better role, a new assignment, or an offer from another company. Your dealings with senior colleagues will become easier, and an earlier workplace issue will settle without much trouble. Business owners will attract new customers and will see better response to their products or services. This period will be particularly active for those working in beauty, fashion, media, design, hospitality, entertainment, or creative fields.

horoscopes.title: Pisces Weekly Horoscope Starting September 27
content: This is a very important phase for your workplace as Mars is moving through Leo. There will be some complex projects, but you will somehow manage to finish it. A disagreement with a colleague will come into the open, especially over responsibilities or the way a job is being handled. Job seekers will actively attend interviews and tests, while those preparing for competitive examinations will have a demanding schedule. A loan, debt, or pending payment will need attention, and some will make a major repayment. Legal disputes will also move forward. Health-wise, fever, inflammation, minor injuries, or muscular pain will require care, particularly if your routine becomes physically exhausting.

The Sun will move through your eighth house, and money shared with others will become an important matter during this period. You will have to deal with taxes, insurance, loans, inheritance, or a payment that has been pending for some time. Married people will discuss their partner’s income, debts, savings, or a major expense that both have to handle. Some will receive money through an insurance settlement, family asset, or other financial source, but paperwork will take time. An old property or inheritance issue will come up again. There will also be expenses connected with medical needs or repairs. Documents involving tax, banking, insurance, or joint assets will require closer attention.

Venus will impact your ninth house, and there will be pleasant developments connected with travel, higher studies, and people living far away. A long-distance trip with your partner or family will come up, and some will begin planning an overseas holiday. Students will receive good news regarding admission, university applications, scholarships, or courses abroad. Those already living away from home will get an opportunity to travel or visit family. A relationship with someone from another city or country will become more serious. People working with foreign clients, universities, publishing, travel, or international business will receive useful opportunities. A family celebration or important event will also bring a journey.
